Video Editor · free, in your browser

Make a split screen video

Pick a layout, such as two side by side, three in a row, a 2×2 or 3×3 grid or picture-in-picture, then drop a clip into each cell. Video Editor gives each its own track and exports one video.

Open Video Editor

How to do it

  1. Open Video Editor, drop your clips on the page and open the Templates tab (Shift+G).
  2. Pick a layout: 2×1 for two columns, 1×2 for two rows, 3×1, 2×2, 3×3, Picture-in-picture, or Custom… up to 4×4.
  3. Drag a clip from the media bin onto each cell in the monitor, or into each slot in the panel.
  4. Drag a filled slot onto another to swap them. Each slot is its own track, so you can trim them one by one.
  5. Press Export and choose the size, such as Landscape 1920×1080 or Phone 1080×1920.

Your files stay on this device: Video Editor runs in your browser, with no upload, no account and no watermark.

Questions

Are the clips cropped to fit the cells?

No. Each clip is fitted inside its cell with letterboxing, so nothing is cut off.

Can the layout change during the video?

Yes. On the Layout lane, choose another layout and press Switch at playhead. Each band keeps its layout until the next switch.

Whose sound plays?

Each clip keeps its linked sound on its own audio track. Mute or turn down the ones you do not want.
